pull_quotes: No public school shall allow a male student athlete to participate on a girls’ sports team nor shall a public school allow a female athlete to participate on a boys sports team.

bills.description: Relative to procedures for parental notification of changes to the mental, emotional, or physical health or well-being of students. Education.
bills.title: Relative to Parental Rights in Education
pull_quotes: Instruction by school personnel or third parties on sexual orientation or gender identity shall not occur in Kindergarten through Grade 3.

bills.description: Relative to sports teams at public schools. Education.
bills.title: To ensure fairness and safety in school sports
pull_quotes: No public school shall require any student athlete on a single-sex sports team to participate in a match, or any part thereof, against an opposing team that includes one or more athletes of the opposite sex. No penalty, including but not limited to loss of playing time or loss of starting status, shall be imposed by a public school on such a student athlete for refusing to play in such a match.
